story.title: North Korea Conducts Intermediate-Range Missile Test Amid Tensions with Seoul
story.summary: North Korea has confirmed the successful test of an intermediate-range strategic missile, as stated by Kim Yo Jong, sister of leader Kim Jong Un. This missile test follows demands from Seoul for an apology regarding recent border incidents involving mine blasts.

timeline_highlights.title: South Korea Seeks Apology from North Korea Over DMZ Landmine Incident
timeline_highlights.summary: South Korea has demanded an apology from North Korea following a landmine explosion on September 21 that injured three South Korean soldiers in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). The South Korean military attributed the blast to North Korean mines, prompting calls for 'responsible measures' from Pyongyang. North Korea has denied involvement in the incident.

timeline_highlights.title: North Korea Fires Ballistic Missile Amid Rising Tensions with South Korea
timeline_highlights.summary: North Korea launched a ballistic missile from the Wonsan area into the Sea of Japan on Saturday morning, according to South Korea's military. This missile test follows heightened tensions between the two Koreas, particularly after South Korea demanded an apology regarding a mine blast that injured three South Korean soldiers in the Demilitarized Zone last month. The missile reportedly flew over 700 kilometers before landing in the sea.

The launch occurred amid tensions over a mine blast that injured South Korean soldiers.

related_stories.title: FlyDubai Co-Pilot Attacked Captain with Axe, Barred from Flying Over Extremism Concerns
related_stories.summary: The co-pilot of a FlyDubai flight to Israel, identified as Omani national Hamam al-Hammami, attacked the captain with an axe in what UAE officials describe as an attempted terrorist act. Al-Hammami had previously been barred from flying in Oman due to concerns over extremist views. The incident has raised alarms within the aviation industry, already struggling from recent crises.
